entries.device: Samsung Galaxy A04 SM-A045M (Knox Warranty Bit 1; broken touch)
entries.method: Windows ADB + verified official Core APK + community USB helper and private Hub QR data
evidence: Android 14 API 34 ARM64; bootloader locked, verified boot green, Knox warranty bit 1; August 2026 patch
Acurast Lite work-profile user 11/profile owner removed via Lite uninstall; only user 0 and no owners remained
Official Core 1.29.0 installed through adb install with Success; versionCode 144 confirmed
Pinned helper SHA-256s matched; synthetic and private real-payload on-device check succeeded
Android set-device-owner returned explicit Success; dpm list-owners confirmed DeviceOwner and Affiliated on user 0
Owner reported Core configuring/enrollment screen after launch; scrcpy connection was lost during dedicated setup
Owner reported Core enrollment completed after using in-app Install executor for Executors not installed
No A04-specific fresh Hub recent-connection/attestation evidence supplied; do not infer Online
Later owner shared a private local dashboard screenshot associated with already-identified Redmi, not the Samsung A04 Hub Phones entry

issues.symptom: Ghost touches required scrcpy control; scrcpy disconnected during Core configuring
issues.observed_action: Owner continued observation of device after USB launch; mouse OTG use was considered but not independently confirmed
issues.outcome: Owner reported completed Core enrollment; reliable post-lockdown physical control remains a caution

issues.symptom: Core UI showed Executors not installed after onboarding
issues.observed_action: Owner used the Acurast Core app's local Install executor option
issues.outcome: Owner reported completion of initial setup; no fresh A04 Hub Online/attestation screenshot was supplied

risk_notes: Do not label Hub Online or attested from UI-only owner report; explicit Hub last-seen/attestation confirmation still pending
Knox warranty bit 1 does not universally prove eligibility; success applies only to this exact guided model and software context
Different from upstream SM-A045F stock-restore case; this SM-A045M test did not flash firmware
Device Owner is potentially irreversible: never auto-run, repeat after failure, reset, bypass device controls or undermine security
QR transported privately and its signature is not cryptographically verified by local helper; staged QR cleanup unverified
Touch was unreliable and scrcpy disconnected; independent OTG control had not been proven
Never treat another processor or self-hosted monitoring dashboard as Hub attestation evidence for this A04

risk_notes: Android helper check does not validate cryptographic Hub pairing signature

Private QR file cleanup on phone after Core lockdown is unverified
Never publish QR, wallet, signatures, account, email, serial, IMEI or raw screenshots
